items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn reusable_credential(
    data_dir: Option<&Path>,
    gh_config: Option<&Path>,
    host: Option<&str>,
) -> Option<String> {
    data_dir
        .filter(|dir| !dir.as_os_str().is_empty())
        .and_then(stored_credential)
        .or_else(|| gh_config.and_then(|directory| token_from_gh_config(directory, host?)))
}
